sections.Profile:
"Mr. Doom" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in January 1979. The game accommodates up to four players and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two sets of three-bank drop targets, two messenger balls, and a spinning target. Notably, it shares the same playfield design as Recel's 1978 "Mr. Evil."

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1979
